title: ICC chamber issues Al-Masri warrant on hostage-taking allegation
affected_population: hostages held in the Gaza Strip
summary: The warrant announcement separately identifies hostage-taking among alleged war crimes.
claim: The Chamber stated that it found reasonable grounds to believe Al-Masri was responsible for the war crime of taking hostages.
legal_characterization: Arrest-warrant allegation at the reasonable-grounds-to-believe threshold; not a conviction.
source_title: Situation in the State of Palestine: ICC Pre-Trial Chamber I issues warrant of arrest for Mohammed Diab Ibrahim Al-Masri (Deif)
source_page: Web release, section headed “The warrant of arrest”
verification_notes: Verified against the ICC’s official warrant announcement and its stated reasonable-grounds threshold. The record does not treat the warrant as a conviction. ICC Pre-Trial Chamber I subsequently terminated the proceedings against Al-Masri on 26 February 2025 following notification of his death (ICC-01/18-417); the 21 November 2024 warrant claim is retained only as a historical procedural allegation and is not presented as an active current proceeding.
